task_summary: Implement inclusive integer range behavior in solution.py, add public unittest regression coverage, and document design decisions plus the verification command in HANDOFF.md.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace.
Edit solution.py and public tests; HANDOFF.md is an allowed output.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Do not access parent repositories or external services.
Return integers from start through stop inclusive, stepping +1 or -1 as appropriate; equal endpoints produce a singleton.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least 3 passing unittest methods exercising the public API.
HANDOFF.md must include design decisions and the verification command.

success_criteria.description: solution.py contains a typed public function definition; its location and name are not specified in the request.
Public unittest regression coverage includes at least three test methods in test_solution.py.

check.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); assert sum(isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name.startswith("test") for n in ast.walk(tree)) >= 3'

success_criteria.description: The unittest suite passes using the requested discovery command.
HANDOFF.md records design decisions and the requested verification command.

check.command: python -c 'from pathlib import Path; text = Path("HANDOFF.md").read_text(); assert "design" in text.lower() and "python -m unittest discover -v" in text'

verification.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); assert sum(isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name.startswith("test") for n in ast.walk(tree)) >= 3'
python -c 'from pathlib import Path; text = Path("HANDOFF.md").read_text(); assert "design" in text.lower() and "python -m unittest discover -v" in text'

assumptions: The named relative paths solution.py, test_solution.py, and HANDOFF.md are interpreted relative to the supplied task workspace; requested output files may not exist yet and may be created.
The public API's function name and precise signature are unspecified; the caller should expose a typed public function that accepts start and stop, and tests can discover and exercise that API.
The regex check requires at least one typed top-level function definition in solution.py; if the intended public API has another structure or location, that is subject to review.
The unittest suite is assumed discoverable by `python -m unittest discover -v` from the workspace root.
The requested integer-range behavior is assumed to apply to integer start and stop arguments; exact validation behavior for other input types is unspecified.
